_about: Public-domain Charles Trimnell, Bishop of Norwich and then of Winchester, for the Word Hoard: his sermons before the House of Commons, the House of Lords, the Lord Mayor, the Sons of the Clergy, the Society for the Propagation of the Gospel and the Societies for Reformation of Manners, and his tracts in the Convocation controversy. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 123 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
